{{Quote|I've been ''drugged'', you fools! It's the work of the ''wheel administrator''!|Zertik Strom|<ref name="MSW23">[[Star Wars (1977) 23|''Star Wars'' (1977) 23]]</ref>}}
'''Immunity programming''' was a procedure undertaken by certain [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]]. It allowed them to fight off the effects of certain drugs. For instance, a drug designed to make a [[Human/Legends|human]] sleep for hours might be shaken off in a much shorter time, and far more of the drug would be required to take effect at all. The immunity programming was effective even while the subject was unconscious. [[Sector Commander]] [[Zertik Strom/Legends|Zertik Strom]] had received immunity programming.<ref name="MSW23" />
